message.content: {"version":"1","text":"You are dressed for a New Year's evening at an upscale restaurant, where the chocolate blouse and trousers create a warm base, while the blue blazer adds a layer of sharp sophistication perfect for formal occasions. The gold-and-silver jewelry, including the sparkling pink headband and subtle black stud earrings, bring festive detail without overwhelming your look. Grey wool scarf, beige belt, red bag, and chocolate ankle boots complete the palette with rich tones that stand out beautifully in cool autumn weather.","how_to_wear":["Tuck your blouse into the straight trousers to define the waist, letting the peplum silhouette add volume where it flatters you.","Layer the navy blazer over the blouse for structure when indoors, or open it and wear it as a vest for evening warmth.","Wrap the grey scarf loosely around your neck to soften the jacket's sharp lines or tie it at the waist for a chic, asymmetrical detail.","Pair the chunky ankle boots with slim-fit trousers that skim the leg to maintain an elegant vertical line from hip to heel."],"wrong_photos":[],"swap":{"item":"#237·32","why":"colour","to":"gold"}},"named":[{"n":"#13·30","what":"silk dinner."},{"n":"#238·31","text":"Straight-leg trousers crafted from a warm camel-colored wool blend that fall cleanly to the ankle, providing a modern and polished foundation for your festive outfit without adding unnecessary volume."},{"n":"#479·11","text":"A tailored navy blue blazer featuring prominent shoulder accents and double-breasted styling, lending instant structure and authority while remaining fluid enough for evening wear."},{"n":"#189·15","text":"An ornate wide headband in soft pink velvet studded with pearls and glittering crystals that catches the light at a restaurant party, adding a touch of glamour to your curly hair."},{"n":"#297·20","text":"A sleek beige leather belt with a substantial silver buckle that cinches your waist neatly over the blouse and trousers, defining your shape without constriction."},{"n":"#237·32","text":"Tiny gold-tone hoop earrings that sit close to the earlobe, offering just enough shine to complement your jewelry without competing with the larger headband."},{"n":"#492·26","text":"A lightweight grey wool kerchief that can be draped casually at the neck or wrapped into a stylish knot at the waist, adding texture and neutral warmth to visually."},{"n":"#155·06","text":"A vibrant red leather shoulder bag with an intricate braided chain strap that stands out against darker tones and offers practical storage for essentials during
